leafRule: digest = keccak256(utf8(the record as canonical JSON)); leaf = keccak256(0x00 || digest); node = keccak256(0x01 || min(a, b) || max(a, b)); an odd node is carried up. Canonical JSON: object keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit (JavaScript's default sort), no whitespace, null kept, strings escaped exactly as JavaScript's JSON.stringify does (only \" \\ and control characters: \b \f \n \r \t, the others as \u00xx in lowercase hex; non-ASCII characters and / are not escaped; a lone UTF-16 surrogate, which UTF-8 cannot carry, is written as \udxxx in lowercase hex, as JSON.stringify does since ES2019), integers in plain decimal. DeliveryRoots.verify(dayNumber, digest, proof) on the contract returns true for a record of that day. Each leaf is a vet402-evm-purchase record from one export row: salt = 0x + sha256(utf8 "vet402/celo-weekly/v0/eip155:42220/" + purchase_id) as lowercase hex; network eip155:42220 and spent_units > 0; attempted_at, purchase_id, resource_key, request_query, request_body, spent_units, confirmed_units, tx_hash, http_status_paid, l2_reading; amountAtomic is confirmed_units when that is a positive integer, otherwise null; payer is vet402's EVM wallet; payTo is null (not in the export); asset is Celo USDC; responseBytes and bodyHash are null. Rows are sorted by attempted_at then purchase_id. Week = UTC Monday 00:00 through Sunday 24:00; record(day, root, n) uses day = that Sunday's dayNumber.
policy: A leaf holds facts only, taken from the public observatory export; no verdict is in the root. Every purchase in the week is published with its record and proof.
